name: io.github.say1j/tronenergyfrog
title: TronEnergyFrog
description: Live TRON Energy prices and rental for USDT TRC-20 transfers, paid by x402 USDC or API key.

environmentVariables.name: TRONENERGYFROG_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional account API key from @tron_energy_frog_bot. Enables balance, fee check and rent_energy.

environmentVariables.name: TRONENERGYFROG_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Base wallet key that pays x402 quotes in USDC. Use a dedicated low-balance wallet.

environmentVariables.name: TRONENERGYFROG_MAX_PAYMENT_USD
environmentVariables.description: Per-payment USDC cap for pay_x402_quote. Default 5.
